correctness.rationale: In a closed rank-at-most-one sentence, each quantifier matrix has only its own possible free variable; above those quantifiers, splitting disjunction on the singleton empty assignment reduces to ordinary disjunction by the empty-team property. In the matrix, a support-preserving induced restriction preserves quantifier-free satisfaction on any retained subteam and is downward closed, so a true universal persists. An existential is equivalent to the existence of a satisfying singleton by downward closure, and singleton matrix truth depends only on its colour. This proves the necessary order property, up to isomorphism. For the converse, U_{t,k} recognizes n_t<=k because its non-t disjunct cannot receive t and each constancy disjunct can receive at most one t-assignment; if there are at most k, the required split exists. U_{t,0} is literal colour exclusion. Guards select the exact support, and in the positive multiplicity orthant, Dickson's lemma gives a finite antichain of minimal exclusions, each avoided by a disjunction of the upper bounds n_t<=b_t−1. Empty and full fibres, and the empty class, are covered by this construction. In pure equality, the exact one-variable team capacities are zero/infinite for false/true literals, one for constancy, and infinite for dependence with a nonempty determining tuple (only x can occur). Conjunction takes min, splitting disjunction adds; overlap never raises the bound, and a disjoint split realizes it. Every finite capacity is bounded by the number of constancy occurrences by induction. Existentials have constant truth across nonempty sets, and the outer min/max of cutoffs must select a universal cutoff k if the whole spectrum is {1,...,k}. The k-fold constancy split attains that cost. The checker was inspected, not run; in its synthesis check it selects the support in code, so that specific test checks the obstruction formula on an already selected fibre, not a direct evaluation of the written existential guard. The general proof covers the guard independently.

evidence: For a finite unary signature, an induced unary restriction that retains every realized colour is equivalent, up to isomorphism, to coordinatewise decrease within a positive support fibre. equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Shrinking a team at fixed domain is not shrinking the whole model in a sentence interpretation. Even on the full-team diagonal, the InqBT theorem allows the FO property X empty or |D|>=3, which does not obey the pure-set rank-one spectrum constraint. Thus the two classifications are not the same under a change of vocabulary.

originality.rationale: The exact rank-one classification on finite unary structures, the associated formula construction, and the sharp pure-set occurrence bound survive the comparison. Downward closure, the expressive behavior of constancy over teams, and the finite-basis lemma are ingredients, not themselves new results. The closest catalog normal form is for a different logic and a different preservation order; general dependence-logic normal forms and games do not supply this combination of finite-domain expressiveness and syntax-sensitive cost.
residual_risks: Bounded rather than exhaustive priority review. Older rank-preserving normal forms or a quantitative constancy theorem could imply part of the finding, but none of the inspected results supplies these conclusions. The claims do not extend to larger signatures, infinite structures or added team operators.

value.rationale: This gives a complete answer at the first nontrivial quantifier rank for a natural finite-structure class. The exact support-fibre invariant identifies what positive multiplicity information can and cannot be expressed, with finite formula synthesis and a sharp separation between quantifier rank and atom cost. It is more informative than showing unbounded finite thresholds alone.
